expected_behavior: For the float32 input, remainders at indices 0..4 are [5.5,-5.5,0,2,2]. The large input 1e20 is first rounded to float32.
bug_signature: CPU Inductor produces NaN at indices 0..2 and zero at indices 3..4. Remaining lanes preserve vector-loop triggering; their rounding and signed-zero policy are outside the claimed signature. Observed on AVX512 only; not generalized to other vector widths or scalar tails.
